_comment: Curated model lineage DAG (GH#11). Maps a derived model (child) to its parent derivation edge(s). This curated ledger is the PRIMARY source of lineage; raw_family is a weak hint only and is never trusted as lineage. Each entry: child_id is the lowercase match key against a model ID (full ID or the segment after the last '/'); child_ref is the entity-ref identity of the child as a DAG node (used by Ancestors/Descendants traversal); real=true means the child record exists in the models.dev catalog, real=false marks a SYNTHETIC / catalog-absent fixture (curated-only — the child is not in the catalog, only its parents are) that exists here for DAG coverage and is flagged so consumers never mistake it for an attested catalog record. child_ref and each parent may carry an OPTIONAL param_size token (e.g. "70b", "8b"): it renders as the '#paramsize' segment of the entity key (family[/variant][@version][#paramsize]{mods}) so a SIZED entity is linked to its lineage rather than de-linked. param_size is SIZE-AGNOSTIC when OMITTED: because Ancestors/Descendants fall back from a sized entity key to its size-stripped form, an unsized edge applies to EVERY sized sibling by default (and stays byte-identical to its pre-size form for unsized entities). SPECIFY param_size to bind an edge to exactly one size — a size-specific edge WINS over the unsized edge for that size (the exact key is tried before the size-stripped fallback) and never leaks to other sizes. Do NOT invent sizes: a size-specific edge only matches an entity whose registry key carries that exact #size, so a wrong/guessed size silently fails to bind (the fallback rescues only the OMITTED case, not a mismatched one). Every parent.family MUST be a known base family (validated at load); an unknown base is rejected.

edges._comment: EVA-Qwen2.5-32B-v0.2 is EVA-UNIT-01's roleplay finetune OF Qwen2.5-32B. Upstream re-spelled the row from the base-leading 'Qwen2.5-32B-EVA-v0.2' to the org-prefixed 'EVA-UNIT-01/EVA-Qwen2.5-32B-v0.2' in the 2026-08-28 refresh; child_id follows the catalog spelling. The curated exact-id family override splits the two identities apart (family 'eva', version '0.2' — EVA's own release line — with the 32B size read off the id), so the base relationship is carried HERE as a derivation edge instead of being smuggled into a compound family token. param_size is pinned on BOTH ends deliberately: the child key really is eva@0.2#32b, and the base is specifically the 32B Qwen2.5 — a size-agnostic edge would claim every Qwen2.5 size as a parent.
